content: निली €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To stick or adhere to, lie or rest upon, settle down or alight upon; निलिल्ये मूर्ध्नि गृध्रोऽस्य <ls>Bk. 14. 76</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">2. 5</ls>. .²2 To lurk or hide, hide oneself in; गुहास्वन्ये न्यलेषत <ls>Bk. 15. 32</ls>; निशि रहसि निलीय <ls>Gīt. 2</ls>. .²3 To hide or conceal oneself from (with <ab>abl.</ab>); मातुर्निलीयते कृष्णः <ls>Sk.</ls> .²4 To die, perish. .²5 To become settled or fixed; पूर्वमेव हि जन्तूनां योधिवासो निलीयते <ls>Rāj. T. 3. 426</ls>.
